mapper.select: SELECT s.seq AS survey_seq, q.seq AS question_seq, q.order_num, q.name, a.seq AS answer_seq, a.contents, qi.seq, qi.content FROM survey s JOIN question q ON s.seq = q.survey_seq LEFT JOIN answer a ON q.seq = a.question_seq JOIN question_item qi ON q.seq = qi.question_seq WHERE s.seq = #{surveySeq}

SELECT s.seq AS survey_seq, s.name AS surveyName, q.seq AS question_seq, s.cc_seq, q.name AS questionName FROM survey s JOIN question q ON s.seq = q.survey_seq WHERE q.cc_seq IN (SELECT seq FROM common_code WHERE parent_seq = 3) AND s.seq = #{surveySeq}
